records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} puts a new beginning next to the practical question of what will hold it up. Saturn is less interested in the first burst of motivation than in the deadline, responsibility, boundary, or commitment that makes the beginning sustainable.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} puts a new beginning next to the practical question of what will hold it up.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: New Moon begins a new cycle | beginnings require room for what comes next

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} makes the consequences of an existing structure easier to see. Saturn can explain why the rule, limit, or commitment exists; the Full Moon shows who has actually been carrying it and what happens if nothing changes.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} makes the consequences of an existing structure easier to see.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Full Moon as culmination | axis reveals a tension already in motion

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can open a new path before the structure around it is ready. Saturn is the part of the sky that asks what the choice will require after the first move, especially when time, money, authority, or responsibility cannot be improvised later.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can open a new path before the structure around it is ready.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Solar eclipse as a supercharged New Moon | new paths emerge while events are still unfolding

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can expose the weak point a system has been surviving by asking someone to keep covering it. Saturn shows the formal structure; the eclipse makes the accumulated consequence much harder to ignore.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can expose the weak point a system has been surviving by asking someone to keep covering it.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Lunar eclipse as culmination and revelation | what is in motion is still unfolding
